zh.title: 飛機為何多數漆成白色？實用原因解析
zh.summary: 減少熱吸收；易於檢查損壞；降低維護成本；租賃公司偏好
body: 根據《Aerospace Global News》報導，大多數商用飛機漆成白色主要基於實用考量。白色表面能反射更多陽光，降低飛機外殼溫度，減少熱應力對材料的影響。
白色飛機外殼有助於工程師更易發現損壞、腐蝕和液體洩漏。油污、液壓油和灰塵等污染物在白色表面上更明顯，便於日常檢查。
白色塗裝可降低維護成本。白色褪色或瑕疵較不顯眼，減少重漆需求。對大型機隊而言，統一塗裝能簡化維護程序。
飛機租賃公司也偏好白色飛機。白色外觀能保持較長時間的美觀，減少因顏色老化而需重新噴漆的頻率。

en.title: Why Most Airplanes Are Painted White: Practical Reasons
en.summary: Reduce heat absorption; easier damage inspection; lower maintenance costs; leasing company preference
body: According to Aerospace Global News, most commercial airplanes are painted white for practical reasons. White surfaces reflect more sunlight, keeping aircraft exteriors cooler and reducing thermal stress on materials.
White aircraft exteriors help engineers detect damage, corrosion, and fluid leaks. Oil, hydraulic fluid, and dirt are more visible on white surfaces during routine inspections.
White paint reduces maintenance costs. Fading or minor imperfections are less noticeable on white, minimizing repainting needs. For large fleets, uniform livery simplifies maintenance procedures.
Aircraft leasing companies also prefer white planes. The color maintains aesthetic appeal longer, reducing the frequency of repainting due to color degradation.

sources.name: Aerospace Global News — The surprising reason most airplanes are painted white News

facts.claim: White paint helps keep aircraft cooler by reflecting sunlight.
facts.sourceQuote: White surfaces reflect more sunlight than darker colours. This helps reduce the amount of solar energy absorbed by the aircraft, keeping its exterior cooler when parked on the ground or flying in direct sunlight.

facts.claim: White exteriors make damage and contamination more visible during inspections.
facts.sourceQuote: A white exterior provides a useful background against which many types of damage and contamination can be identified. Oil, hydraulic fluid, soot and other dark substances are often easier to spot on a white surface than on a darker one.

facts.claim: White paint can reduce maintenance costs for large fleets.
facts.sourceQuote: White is often a practical choice because fading, discolouration and minor cosmetic imperfections can be less conspicuous than they are on certain darker or more elaborate finishes.

facts.claim: Aircraft leasing companies prefer white airplanes for aesthetic longevity.
facts.sourceQuote: Many airlines do not own every aircraft they operate. Instead, they lease aircraft from specialist companies
